title: An unrestricted grammar for a context-sensitive language
notes: A and B mark the ends; C walks right doubling every a, D walks back, and E erases the markers. CB → E shrinks the string, so the grammar is unrestricted. It generates aᵏ for k a power of 2, and that language is context-sensitive: a linear-bounded automaton decides it by halving.
ops: S -> ACaB | a; Ca -> aaC; CB -> DB | E; aD -> Da; AD -> AC; aE -> Ea; AE -> eps
